# Stockfish

These files are the "lite, single-threaded" WebAssembly build of the Stockfish chess engine,
taken unmodified from the npm package `stockfish` version 19.0.1
(Stockfish.js by Nathan Rugg, https://github.com/nmrugg/stockfish.js;
engine source: https://github.com/official-stockfish/Stockfish).

Stockfish is free software licensed under the GNU General Public License, version 3.
The full licence text is in `Copying.txt`. If you pass this app on to anyone else, the
GPL applies to it: include this folder and make the source available.
